label: Landscaping
headline_template: Keeps the yard looking like someone lives here.
lede_template: Mowing, cleanup, and the jobs that pile up in {city}.

services.name: Mowing and edging
services.what: Weekly or biweekly cuts so the yard doesn’t get away from you.
services.benefit: The house looks kept when someone drives by or a tenant moves in.

services.name: Cleanup
services.what: Leaves, fallen branches, and the mess after a windy week.
services.benefit: Get the yard walkable again without a full weekend of bags.

services.name: Trees and shrubs
services.what: Overgrown hedges, a tree on the lines, or a plant that’s dying in place.
services.benefit: Shape it or take it out before it hits the house or the sidewalk.

services.name: Irrigation
services.what: Heads that miss, a zone that won’t shut off, or a timer nobody understands.
services.benefit: Water the plants, not the driveway, and stop the runoff ticket.

services.name: Mulch and beds
services.what: Bare dirt, weeds taking the beds, or mulch that washed out.
services.benefit: Beds that hold moisture and look finished, not forgotten.

services.name: Seasonal work
services.what: The big jobs that show up with the season — cutbacks, leaf drops, pre-summer prep.
services.benefit: A plan for the yard instead of reacting every time it gets ugly.

process.title: You call the shop
process.body: The number on this page rings them. Say if you need a one-time cleanup or a regular route.

process.title: They tell you if they can take it
process.body: Ask if they cover your street and what day they run your block.

process.title: They look, then they talk
process.body: Someone should walk the yard and say what’s included before the first mow or cut.

faqs.q: How do I know I need a landscaper?
faqs.a: Grass you can’t keep up with, a yard that’s gone after vacation, or irrigation that floods one bed and starves another.

faqs.q: What should I do while I wait?
faqs.a: Move cars off the driveway if they need access. Shut off a broken sprinkler valve if you can find it.
